integrity: All claims have explicit algebraic proof; finite numerical checks are corroboration only. Historical priority is bounded, not certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a prime base field. It gives no extension-field theorem, phaseless recovery, or inverse-condition-number upper bound; twisted Kloosterman magnitudes are exact character sums, not elementary closed forms.
title: Prime-field Fourier sampling on the split-torus normalizer: a twisted-Kloosterman singular spectrum
